data.one_liner: A customizable speedometer gauge widget for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a speedometer‑style gauge chart that displays a value within a configurable range. The widget supports custom colors, pointer style, titles, and animation.
use_when: You need a simple gauge to visualize a single numeric metric
You want a lightweight, pure‑Flutter solution without native dependencies
avoid_when: You require complex multi‑series charts or advanced analytics
You need built‑in support for data streaming or real‑time updates
weaknesses: No built‑in support for data binding or streams

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_gauges
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a broader set of gauge types and richer feature set

alternatives.name: gauge_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar gauge functionality with additional styling options

data.minimal_example:
SpeedometerChart(
  dimension: 200,
  minValue: 0,
  maxValue: 100,
  value: 75,
  graphColor: [Colors.red, Colors.yellow, Colors.green],
  pointerColor: Colors.black,
);
